"id": "P10",
      "title": "Measure proof costs before choosing optimization",
      "layer": "L3",
      "depends_on": [
        "P09"
      ],
      "status": "planned-not-implemented",
      "selection": "recommended-core",
      "problem": "The evaluator was sub-millisecond in recorded full runs; proof preparation/replay dominated. Grounding optimization should remain evidence-driven.",
      "implementation_steps": [
        "Measure cold/warm full qualification, split stages, general replay, explanation and shadow registration in isolated run directories under P06 enforcement.",
        "Record stage parentage and exclusive versus inclusive timing, aggregate memory backend and peak RSS, cache validation, workload and success scope.",
        "Increase one dimension at a time within the declared envelope and distinguish evaluator-only completion from actual kernel qualification.",
        "Choose no optimization unless a measured bottleneck justifies it. Any new optimized evaluator needs independently fixed extensional equivalence targets and actual closure/certificate checks before selection."
      ],
      "contract": "PerformanceReport{workload,mode,resource_policy,stage_tree,peak_memory,actual_kernel_completion,limits,selection}. Inclusive nested times are never summed as independent work.",
      "formal_targets": [
        "conditional if optimized: reference and optimized grounded inventory/closure agree under exact finite-profile hypotheses",
        "claim limit: measured workload results do not establish general throughput or latency"
      ],
      "negative_controls": [
        "Large case passes preflight but exceeds proof deadline.",
        "Cached stale olean; overlapped timers incorrectly totaled.",
        "Optimized evaluator drops a typed inst

The test policy permits 60 seconds per atomic tool, 600 seconds per run, 4 MiB of output and one supervised worker. Its 4 GiB memory setting is advisory on this host: aggregate RSS is observed, not hard-limited. Required cgroup enforcement without a delegated writable backend refuses before launching a worker. Process cleanup and crash-window tests support the stated cooperating-host transaction guarantees. They do not prove resilience to arbitrary filesystem corruption, power loss, a malicious host or races outside the ownership/locking assumptions.

"""Retained supervised mathematics with independently anchored imports and phases."""
from ..p06.worker_context import WorkerContext as SupervisedContext
from ..p03.context import C,BASE,read,check,require,write
from .cache import CacheAnchor
from .runs import record_phase

class WorkerContext(SupervisedContext):
    def __init__(self,job,policy,layout):
        self.cache_check=None
        super().__init__(job,policy)
        for predecessor in ['P05','P06']:
            receipt=read(BASE/(predecessor.lower()+'/task-acceptance.json'))
            require(receipt['result']=='accepted',predecessor+' is not accepted')
            for ref in receipt['artifacts']+receipt['inputs']:check(ref)
            self.trusted += receipt['artifacts']+receipt['inputs']
        self.cache=CacheAnchor(layout);self.trusted += self.cache.references
        self.cache_check=self.cache.verify();self.assert_current()

    def assert_current(self):
        super().assert_current()
        if hasattr(self,'cache'):self.cache.verify()

    def allocate(self,request):
        path=super().allocate(request)
        record_phase(self.job,'request-accepted',request_identity=C.identity(request),cache_check=self.cache_check)
        return path

    def prepare(self,build,info,mode):
        self.cache_check=self.cache.verify()
        require([m['source'] for m in self.cache.metadata['modules']]==info['runtime_sources'],'anchored cache and source projection disagree')
        write(build/'cache-check.json',self.cache_check)
        result=super().prepare(build,info,mode)
        record_phase(self.job,'dependencies-prepared',cache_check=self.cache_check)
        return result

    def compile_default(self,build,modules):
        result=super().compile_default(build,modules)
        record_phase(self.job,'compiled-'+modules[-1][0],cache_check=self.cache_check)
        return result

    def inspect(self,request,result):
        checked=super().inspect(request,result)
        record_phase(self.job,'exact-proof-inspected',request_identity=C.identity(request),cache_check=self.cache_check)
        return checked

criteria.criterion: Measured success/refusal envelopes are reproducible and correctly scoped.
Selection targets the observed bottleneck and preserves fresh replay.
No unsupported speedup or broader-profile guarantee is published.

decisions.decision: Preserve accepted code and operator policy; fixed source-bound timing worker delegates to original bounded tools.
Choose no optimization unless actual measurements justify it; no general throughput extrapolation.
Measure one-variable to three-variable fresh-seed workload with all other primary dimensions fixed.
decisions.resolution: normalization must confirm actual work bound; exhaustion stays nonqualified
